entry.title: Updated: dsh-tool-vision
entry.summary: Local-first structured vision for text-only agents: images go to a local OpenAI-compatible VLM and come back as JSON evidence (summary, verbatim OCR, layout regions, entities/relations, colors, explicit uncertainty), with anti-hallucination fallback and an optional paste/upload bridge; zero cloud cost, images never leave the machine. Exact install spec: github:gloryxpnv/dsh-tool-vision. Source event: dsh-market/dsh-market; changed: sources.
